strings.#006CF9F4: At last a Jedi, the temptations of the dark side almost proved too much for Luke Skywalker in his final confrontation with Darth Vader, the man he’d discovered was his father. After uncovering a sinister plot by the Confederacy, the Quarrens and Mon Calamari rallied together to liberate their planet. With the Emperor's reign spreading across the galaxy, the Rebellion also started to grow in strength. Many humans from the Core Worlds and Outer Rim subjugated by the Empire, rose up to fight for the ones who couldn't. Even humans from within Imperial ranks started to defect as they saw through the propaganda of the tyrannical Empire.

strings.#30348D36:
The Sullustans were a peaceful and technologically advanced species renowned for their research and manufacturing on the lava planet Sullust. Their bodies were also naturally resilient due to the harsh conditions on the planet, and were skilled in tunneling, piloting and demolitions.

When the Empire assumed control over Sullust, the general population continued to live peacefully, accepting the way of life brought by the new administration. But some considered the grueling work conditions excessive and began supplying the Rebellion with resources and technology from under the nose of their own government. A small fraction even severed ties with their homeworld to fight for the Rebellion.

Strong willed and defiant, the Zabraks fought against the Empire's escalating attempts to subvert them. Rather than surrendering, many joined the Rebel Alliance, fearlessly fighting their oppressors.

strings.#D90DCD80: Lando was determined to retire from the life of a smuggler and instead become a full-time gambler when he was challenged by Han Solo in a card game on Vandor. Although Lando nearly met his match in the young Corellian, when it came to risking his pride and joy, the Millennium Falcon, he left nothing to chance.
strings.#D93E1E11: If she is within 15 meters of two friendly units, Leia and her close allies will have {0:s}% damage reduction.
strings.#D9403C33: Overseeing Citadel Station’s prison on Lola Sayu, the ruthless warden Osi Sobeck reinforced his B1 guard details with merciless commando droids.
strings.#D9BBC963: Yoda deal {0:s} more damage with his lightsaber strikes to enemy Heroes.
strings.#DAB7FB0E: If ROCKET BARRAGE deals more than 500 damage to enemies for one activation, its cooldown time is reduced for the next usage.
strings.#DB5CF9B9: Inside the secret cloning facilities on Kamino, cadets sparred against training droids in simulated battle scenarios.
strings.#DD0D23AF: ROCKET BARRAGE's rockets deal bonus damage at the center of the explosion in a 1-meter radius.
strings.#DD24D8A8: Han Solo charges forwards, knocking over and damaging the first enemy he hits. Enemies are damaged and staggered when blocking.
strings.#DE037711: Increase the base damage of HEROIC MIGHT by {0:s}.
strings.#DEB7E58D: After blocking 5 blaster shots, 2 abilities or lightsaber attacks with his block, Obi-Wan gains a permanent reduction of 2% to all his stamina costs to a maximum. This effect resets when Obi-Wan is defeated.
strings.#DF4B7CCA: ELECTROCUTE will shock enemies for a {0:s} longer duration if it hits three or more targets.
strings.#DFCAFC7A: The blast radius of THERMAL DETONATORS is increased.
strings.#E1782AF6: FOR THE HUNT reveals enemies for {0:s} seconds longer.
strings.#E1998884: Every enemy trooper defeat or 200 damage to villains decreases all of Anakin Skywalker's stamina costs by 2% to a maximum of {0:s}%. This effect resets when Anakin is defeated.
strings.#E2D1B48C: Seduced by the prospect of a life as con artist, smuggler, and all-around crook, Han threw in with Tobias Beckett and a small-time crew of scoundrels planning a big-time heist. After their plan to steal coaxium was thwarted by a rival gang, Han soon found himself mingling with the criminal elite, leading to a reunion with his childhood friend, Qi’ra.
strings.#E359B0C4: When killing an enemy, Darth Vader gains {0:s}% stamina back.
strings.#E3D58D9B: The cooldown of THERMAL DETONATORS is reduced.
strings.#E4F1AF15: Following the destruction of the Death Star, Han Solo, Luke Skywalker, and Chewbacca were celebrated in the Great Temple on the jungle-covered moon of Yavin 4. Having been called all sorts of things over a career as a smuggler and con artist, Han was least comfortable with his newest description: “respectable”.
strings.#E501C862:
Far superior to battle droids, clone troopers formed the backbone of the Grand Army of the Republic. Bred from the genetic template of the bounty hunter Jango Fett, they represented the latest evolution in galactic warfare.

The Coruscant Guard was a division of elite clone shock troopers once assigned to protect the capital of the Galactic Republic under the guidance of Commander Fox.
strings.#E64F1D57: Missing from the Alliance for some time, a bearded Han Solo finally turns up at Maz Kanata’s castle on Takodana. He’s in search of an informant who may hold the key to liberating the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk from the last remnants of the Empire. And maybe in search of a free drink from Maz while he’s at it.
strings.#E6E89057: Iden Versio's TL-50 builds {0:s} less heat.
strings.#E70BF185: Iden sends her droid to an enemy in front of her, stunning the target. The stun can chain to nearby enemies.
strings.#E921ECE0: Yoda instantly heals himself and allies around him. When the ability is activated, he will also break out of any immobilizing effect.
strings.#EC04CEE5: Every time Chewbacca deals a threshold of 200 combined damage with any ability, he gains 2% damage reduction to a maximum of {0:s}. This effect resets after Chewbacca is defeated.
strings.#EC522008: Darth Vader chokes a cluster of enemies ahead of him, dragging them off the ground and through the air to drop them into danger.
strings.#EC73B87D: I FEEL THE GOOD IN YOU
strings.#ECF152E1: Whether in his role as Count of his homeworld Serenno, as a former member of the Jedi Order, or as the powerful Sith Lord known as Darth Tyranus, Dooku wore elegant garments befitting his elevated status.
strings.#ECFC4930: The E-11 RAPID FIRE time reduction per blaster shot is decreased by {0:s}.
strings.#ED25EB46: General Grievous deals extra damage with his lightsaber attacks but they drain 25% more stamina.
strings.#ED64909B: YOU ARE NO MATCH FOR ME
strings.#ED64909C: AT LAST I WILL HAVE MY REVENGE
strings.#EE019270:
Abednedos evolved deep underground on their homeworld. Their strange, dangling mouth tendrils are remnants of sensory organs that helped their ancestors to navigate in the dark tunnels below the surface.

As sympathizers of the Rebellion, their homeworld became an Imperial target when the late Emperor Palpatine initiated Operation Cinder and the planet faced destruction. From this moment on, the Abednedos elected to become part of the New Republic.
strings.#EE6FB1A1: Strong-willed, Iden Versio chose to break from Imperial protocol and engage enemy forces without her helmet whenever she believed it was to her tactical advantage.
strings.#EEFC9CB0:
Kadas’sa’Niktos, a subspecies of Niktos more commonly known as green Niktos, were prominent in Hutt Space, and hailed from the planet Kintan. With their coarse and scaly dark skin, the green Niktos were fit to survive in harsh desert climates, making them highly desired as enforcers for the Hutt crime families.

As the Empire's control in the sector started to become unbearable, some green Niktos opted to fight for the Rebellion. Some simply sought freedom and justice for the galaxy, while others had ulterior, more selfish motives.
strings.#F1F31DFE: Leia Organa deploys a squad shield at her location. Inside the safety of her shield, Leia is able to be protected from blaster fire and regenerate some health.
strings.#F1F959EA: Increase the range of RESTRICTIVE MIND TRICK by {0:s}.
strings.#F20FA243: Bossk throws out three sticky mines that detonate on proximity trigger, dealing high damage.
strings.#F263B2BE: From his earliest days as one of the underworld’s most charming rogues, many who’ve known Lando have associated his grandiose, self-perpetuated legend with a passion for the finer things in life. From the Millennium Falcon’s pristine white interiors to a closet stocked with the finest clothes money could buy, Lando embodied the phrase, “The cape makes the man.”
strings.#F309A7E9: ELECTROCUTE has a {0:s} increased area of effect.
strings.#F3131AF1: Increase lightsaber damage by {0:s} but they drain {0:s} more stamina.
strings.#F3F1533E: Darth Maul crafted his double-bladed lightsaber to exact vengeance upon the Jedi.
strings.#F423EEBA: For every 10% health missing, General Grievous gains {0:s} damage reduction but his health regeneration speed is halved.
strings.#F5365615: Boba Fett's abilities cooldown are {0:s}% faster while in air, but his health regeneration starts 1.5 second later.
strings.#F5AB0085: FOCUSED RAGE has an active duration extended by 6 seconds, but its bonus damage is reduced.
strings.#F5CEF8FB:
Rodians are reptilians with a ridge of spines on their skulls. With enormous bulbous eyes as well as a pair of saucer-shaped antennae, they are known for being great hunters.

When their home planet Rodia fell under Imperial control, some Rodians opposed this and many members were recruited by the Rebel Alliance.
strings.#F5D32E47: After the Rebel’s surprise victory at the Battle of Yavin, Princess Leia Organa joined forces with Evaan Verlaine to protect survivors of their doomed home world, Alderaan, who were being targeted by the Empire. Leia sought out many of Alderaan’s remaining citizens from worlds such as Naboo and Sullust, reuniting them to ensure their continued safety.
strings.#F64F711E:
Migrant by nature or perhaps necessity, humans fearlessly explored the vastness of space to find places they could call their own under their own terms, making them the most predominant species in the galaxy. While the planet they originally hail from is still debated, the Core World Coruscant is widely considered the human homeworld.

At the end of the Clone Wars when the Republic became the Galactic Empire, many high ranking human officers remained loyal to the new regime. As the clone troopers were gradually phased out in favor of human conscripts, many more humans went through rigorous officer training on Coruscant and at Imperial academies throughout the galaxy to serve their Emperor with unquestionable loyalty.
strings.#F8002926: Darth Vader receives less damage while FOCUSED RAGE is active.
strings.#F85F2977: Lando Calrissian is a ‘legitimate businessman’ who was unexpectedly awarded the rank of General by the Rebel Alliance and charged with leading the assault on the second Death Star.  For the attack, Han Solo ’loaned’ Lando the Millennium Falcon, reuniting him with the ship he’d lost to Solo years earlier. Lando and co-pilot Nien Nunb successfully infiltrated the Death Star’s reactor core, firing the shot that destroyed the battle station.
